about_the_game:
Merge Maestro is a rogue-like MergeBuilder, the first of its kind! Merge Emojis together to create higher level and more powerful Emojis to defeat waves of enemies. Craft your set with hundreds of unique Emojis to create thousands of powerful and wacky combinations. No two runs will ever be the same in this bite sized roguelike!

Gameplay

Place tokens on blank spots on the board and Merge tokens of the same type to make one of a higher tier

Choose a new token to add to your set at the end of every wave

Synergize your build to defeat the ever more challenging enemies that come each wave 

Features:

  • 300+ Unique Emojis to be discovered with unique and game changing interactions

  • 10 themed packs of Tokens that get more and more complex and wacky

  • 6 Difficulty modes that progressively force you to learn and adapt to an ever changing landscape of obstacles

  • 20 Challenges that completely change the way the game is played

Strategies

Construct a city of buildings to passively destroy your enemies every turn

Become and a chef and use foods, fruit and drinks to enhance your tokens in unique ways

Destroy your own tokens and create a relentless undead army

And much, much more!!!
